high_level_description: The image depicts a person sitting on a chair by a large window in what appears to be a hotel room or a similar setting. The individual is wearing a white bathrobe and has their legs crossed. They have long dark hair that falls over their shoulders. Their head is tilted back, and they appear to be either stretching or yawning, with one hand touching their face. The room has a modern and clean aesthetic. There is a floor lamp with a beige shade on the left side of the image, partially obscured by a dark curtain.
